review_notes: Root cause: DrillPointerLike (platform-mcp/src/lib/kala_envelope.ts) had no `args` slot and pointerTo() was a 2-param function, so no caller could embed a required argument (domain/bhava) in a drill pointer at all -- three sibling call sites (now.ts:interpretation_ref, ahead.ts:interpretation_ref, priority.ts:interpretation_ref) all advertised kala_explain_get without the args it hard-requires. Fix adds an optional `args?: Record<string,unknown>` field to DrillPointerLike, an optional 3rd param to pointerTo() (backward compatible -- existing 2-arg callers unaffected, verified by full suite), and a new typed `explainPointerTo(hint, args)` constructor whose args param is non-optional-by-type ({domain}|{bhava}|null) so future call sites cannot silently omit the decision; the null branch degrades honestly (hint states 'pass domain or bhava when calling') rather than fabricating a domain, per CLAUDE.md B.10/N.7. now.ts derives primaryDomain from the strongest active window's first domain; ahead.ts forwards its own optional domain filter; priority.ts forwards domainFilter[0]. explain.ts's inline guard was extracted into an exported explainRequiresDomainOrBhava() (no behavior change, confirmed by unchanged existing explain_kp_voice.test.ts/explain_contrast.test.ts passing) so the fix and its regression test check the actual production guard rather than a re-derived copy that could drift from it -- this was a deliberate choice to satisfy the 'not vacuous' bar (this session's own Opus review earlier tonight flagged hollow tests as a repeat risk). Sibling census re-verified against current source (line numbers shifted from the corpus's prior analysis due to intervening commits, but structure identical): explain.ts->kala_ahead_get, ritual.ts->kala_elect_get, story.ts/elect.ts->get_domain_reading all confirmed NOT this defect class (their targets have no required domain/bhava arg).
